name: spree
description: Claude Code support for Spree Commerce 6.x projects. Ships 38 skills covering project conventions, the customization decision tree (workflow hook vs event subscriber vs provider vs dependency swap vs decorator), Spree::Workflow and Spree.hooks, the API resource generator, decorators, Spree.dependencies, extensions and providers, the v3 REST API (Store, Admin and Seller surfaces, scopes, prefixed IDs), the TypeScript SDKs (@spree/sdk, @spree/admin-sdk, @spree/seller-sdk), the spree CLI, staff roles and permissions, the data model (Cart vs Order, customers, companies, markets), catalog, pricing, inventory, checkout (requirements + Checkout::Registry), order totals (tax lines, discounts, fees), taxes, payments, promotions, fulfillment, returns/exchanges/claims, marketplace (sellers, commissions, payouts), B2B (companies, catalogs), multi-tenant, reporting, the React admin dashboard and dashboard plugins, the Next.js storefront, events + webhooks, i18n, testing, security, performance, deployment, and upgrades (including Spree 5.6 → 6.0). Includes the spree-expert subagent for multi-step Spree work, two slash commands (/spree:doctor — stack diagnosis; /spree:audit-upgrade — upgrade-readiness audit), two safety hooks (block destructive db commands, warn on hardcoded secrets), and the Spree documentation MCP server. For Spree 5.x use v0.3.0.
